root_cause: The feature was merged to main while Netlify production still exposed the previous Git-linked commit, so repository truth and production truth temporarily diverged.
prevention: For material pricing or checkout changes, terminal delivery requires exact current-main source identity in Netlify production.
If Git-linked Netlify does not advance promptly, use the canonical Production Source Snapshot transport rather than declaring the merge live.
Verify pricing content and backend deployment identity after promotion.

evidence.outcome: Promotion candidate forces an exact-source production snapshot and requires exact production identity/readback.
